strategy.title: If Time Ran 10× Faster, Your Body Would Notice First
strategy.hook: A faster clock would reshape sleep, healing, memory, and aging before society could adjust its schedule.

story_structure.opening: Establish normal time and clearly identify the single rule that will change.
story_structure.escalation: Follow three cause-and-effect consequences, increasing the stakes at each step.
story_structure.takeaway: Return to reality and show what the scenario reveals about how time actually works.

strategy.audience: Curious learners who save and share clear visual explanations.
strategy.visual_direction: Cause-and-effect triptych for time; normal baseline on left, altered 10× world at center, cascading consequences on right, cinematic visual continuity
